title: The Guard Stepped Off
setup: Black's rook has just dropped to c7, and nothing is left on the eighth rank but its king.
hint: One black piece was holding the whole eighth rank a move ago. Check whether it still does.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd8#}} ends it. The queen checks along the eighth rank; the rook on c7 can neither take it nor block on e8 or f8, and the wall of pawns on f7, g7 and h7 keeps the king at home. A rook that leaves the back rank must leave a replacement.
